articles.summary: Abercrombie & Fitch is celebrating fall denim with “Denim Made Iconic,” a new campaign inspired by the energy, individuality and style of New York City – where the brand began in 1892. Shot by New York-based photographer Cass Bird across iconic city locations, the campaign brings fashion and sport together with Emily Ratajkowski, Paloma Elsesser.
articles.title: Denim Made Iconic

articles.summary: Hollister is kicking off the fall season with a new women’s denim campaign featuring rising pop star Freya Skye. articles.title: Made for this Moment
